inputs.text: Editorial political cartoon, satirical illustration, a colossal corporate elephant wearing a formal business suit and tie, perched atop a tiny, fragile plastic child's tricycle. Extreme scale contrast, the tricycle is buckling and crushed under the immense weight of the elephant. The elephant holds a giant red "REJECTED" rubber stamp in its trunk. A whirlwind of thousands of white paper resumes and CVs swirls in the background. High contrast ink and watercolor wash, exaggerated caricature, sharp lines, professional editorial style, clean white background.
